fetch_recipe: GET the recorded url exactly (raw Internet Archive id_ form) with no Accept-Encoding request header, or with Accept-Encoding: identity, and no automatic decoding (for example curl -s -o FILE URL, without --compressed), then hash the bytes as received. A client that accepts gzip can receive an on-the-fly gzip body with different bytes, and a decoding client unpacks bodies that the archive stores compressed.
stability_check: First downloaded on 2026-09-25 at 13:00Z by the researcher and downloaded again at 13:45Z; the independent check downloaded it again at 13:52Z. Every download had the same byte count and SHA-256. Downloaded again for this packet at 2026-09-25T15:30Z (integration pass) with the same byte count and SHA-256.
provenance_note: Raw Internet Archive capture (id_ form) of the original page, captured at 2009-04-30T15:17:59Z (before the 7 September 2026 cutoff); that form replays the archived bytes unchanged and is used in place of the live page. Fetched without Accept-Encoding (curl without --compressed), the archive serves it uncompressed: the recorded byte count and SHA-256 are those of the uncompressed body. The response identity was confirmed by downloads at least 30 minutes apart (see stability_check). This checked-in file is a derived factual extract, not a copy of the original response. Original response bodies, PDFs and page renders are not checked into this repository. Its own checksum is recorded separately in the packet.

rows.role_title: Deputy President of the Republic of South Africa
rows.text: The Presidency's profile of the serving Deputy President, as captured on 30 April 2009, lists among Baleka Mbete's current positions 'Deputy President of the Republic of South Africa since September 2008'.

bounded_scope: Deputy President observations for CLAUDE-C01-21 only (role za_deputy_president in za_presidency). Announcements, stated intentions, appointments and their notices, oaths and their scheduling, stated assumptions, releases, resignations and their stated effect, Assembly-seat events and in-office attestations stay separate rows; holder observations and any start or end are decided in the packet, not by any row.
